source_refs.note: Topic 8.7.1 with the following heterogeneous section, printed pages 172-173, with Quick Check 8.3 (a) as the self-check.

blocks.title: Homogeneous equilibrium
blocks.text: An equilibrium system in which all of the reactants and products are in the same phase, for example N2(g) + 3H2(g) giving 2NH3(g); 2SO2(g) + O2(g) giving 2SO3(g); and CH3COOH(l) + C2H5OH(l) giving CH3COOC2H5(l) + H2O(l).

blocks.title: Heterogeneous equilibrium
blocks.text: An equilibrium in which the reactants and products are in more than one phase, for example CaCO3(s) giving CaO(s) + CO2(g); C(s) + H2O(g) giving CO(g) + H2(g); and 3Fe(s) + 4H2O(g) giving Fe3O4(s) + 4H2(g).
